ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25 high-intensity (white) to 0.75 low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white circular rings (rosettes) distributed extensively across the lateral and medial zones of both lobes; central axial region near the notch remains solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees with a vertical depth of ~20% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations and macro-level jagged peaks (amplitude 5-15 pixels) concentrated on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward convex sweep on the leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a sigmoid curve transitioning from distal convexity to proximal concavity near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Ubiquitous spatial distribution of white circular pixel clusters (rosettes) ranging from 10-40 pixels in diameter across the entire surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular depigmentation scars; structural barnacle encrustations present on the distal tips of both lobes causing profile irregularities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-intensity, textured clusters indicating live barnacle colonies on the extreme lateral points of the fluke lobes.
